cases.expected: Returned empty error set; walk body not executed; only post‑walk listeners invoked

cases.description: Pre‑walk listeners return true, so the validator walk is performed. The validator returns null, which makes the collector merge scopes without adding errors.

cases.expected: Returned empty error set; collectorContext merges parent scope with child scope (no errors added)
cases.description: Validator walk returns null. The method should treat it like an empty result, merge the dynamic scopes and return an empty error set.

cases.expected: Returned empty error set; collectorContext merges parent scope with child scope (no errors added)
cases.description: Validator walk returns an empty Set. The method should merge scopes and not add any errors.
